title: Seven Paces; Liu Feng Is Executed
summary: Cao Pi, suspicious of the brother everyone thought should have been heir, orders Cao Zhi to compose a poem in the time it takes to walk seven paces or die. Cao Zhi walks, and produces the beanstalk burning under the pot of beans: 'we grew from the same root — why so eager to burn each other?' Cao Pi lets him live, diminished.
In Shu, Liu Feng is executed for not marching to Maicheng, and Meng Da, who advised him, goes over to Wei.
history: The seven-pace poem is one of the most famous in the language, though its attachment to this scene is later legend. Liu Feng's execution is historical.

pins.note: Seven paces, and the beanstalk under the pot.
Grieving, and beginning to plan a war.
